The A-DIY path

Professional result. Your hands. Your timeline.

A-DIY removes everything that makes traditional DIY overwhelming — so you get the satisfaction of building it yourself without any of the guesswork.

Design Your Deck

Common questions

Everything You Need to Know Before You Order

Do I need any special tools?
Just a standard residential power drill. The drill bit, screws, and all hardware are included in the kit. No circular saw, miter saw, level, or tape measure required.
How long does the build actually take?
Most customers complete their deck in one day. Some smaller configurations take just a few hours. There is no multi-day or multi-weekend commitment.
I've never built anything before. Is this really doable?
Yes. The system was designed specifically for people without construction experience. The 3D visual instructions guide you through every single connection. Customers with zero building background complete their decks successfully every week.
What exactly arrives in the crate?
Everything. Grade 1 kiln-dried pressure-treated lumber (pre-cut and labeled), all galvanized screws and hardware, TuffBlock deck foundations, a custom drill bit, and a full 3D assembly guide. You will not need to make a single trip to a lumber yard or hardware store.
Can I customize the size or add railings and stairs?
Yes. Kits are available in eight standard sizes from 12×12 to 16×28. You can add railings, stairs, and choose your foundation type. The modular design also allows you to combine multiple kits for larger or custom-shaped builds.
Is the structural quality comparable to a contractor-built deck?
Yes. The materials are Grade 1 kiln-dried, pressure-treated lumber with 6×6 beams, 2×8 joists at 13–14 inches on center, and galvanized hardware throughout. The system is engineered to residential code and supports over 15,000 lbs of load.
What if I get stuck or something arrives damaged?
Our expert team is available by phone and email. Replacement parts ship fast. Most issues are resolved the same day. You are never left on your own.
Do I need a permit?
Permit requirements vary by location. Check with your local building authority. If needed, we can provide engineering diagrams to support your permit application.
Still have questions? Book a free call →

you had started this weekend.

/* ── RESET ── */
.ab2 *, .ab2 *::before, .ab2 *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.ab2 {
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.65;
  color: #1c1c19; background: #fff;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

/* ── TOKENS ── */
.ab2 {
  --green:        #396958;
  --green-dark:   #2b5244;
  --green-light:  #eaf3ef;
  --green-mid:    #c2ddd6;
  --blue:         #4177AD;
  --blue-dark:    #305d8a;
  --blue-light:   #e8f0f8;
  --bg:           #F6F4F2;
  --bg-dark:      #1c2620;
  --bg-ink:       #111810;
  --dark:         #1c1c19;
  --mid:          #4c4c47;
  --muted:        #7c7c74;
  --border:       #e0deda;
  --border-strong:#c8c4be;
  --tp-green:     #00b67a;
  --radius:       8px;
  --radius-lg:    14px;
  --shadow-sm:    0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  --shadow:       0 3px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  --shadow-lg:    0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
}

/* ── LAYOUT ── */
.ab2-wrap        { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }
.ab2-wrap.ab2-wrap-rating-block{
max-width: 100%; 
}
.ab2-wrap--mid   { max-width: 900px;  margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }
.ab2-wrap--narrow{ max-width: 720px;  margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }

/* ── TYPOGRAPHY ── */
.ab2-serif {
  font-family: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, serif;
}
.ab2-eyebrow {
  display: inline-block; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--green); margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.ab2-eyebrow--light { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); }

.ab2-h1 {
  font-family: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, serif;
  font-size: clamp(44px, 6.5vw, 80px);
  line-height: 1.0; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #fff;
  font-weight: 400;
}
.ab2-h1 em { font-style: italic; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); }

.ab2-h2 {
  font-family: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, serif;
  font-size: clamp(30px, 4vw, 48px);
  line-height: 1.1; color: var(--dark); font-weight: 400;
}
.ab2-h3 {
  font-family: 'DM Serif Display', Georgia, serif;
  font-size: clamp(20px, 2.8vw, 30px);
  line-height: 1.15; color: var(--dark); font-weight: 400;
}
.ab2-lead { font-size: clamp(16px, 1.8vw, 19px); color: var(--mid); line-height: 1.7; }

/* ── BUTTONS ── */
.ab2-btn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 14px 28px;
  border-radius: 5px; border: 1.5px solid transparent;
  cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none;
  transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s, background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
  white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1;
}
.ab2-btn:hover  { transform: translateY(-2px); }
.ab2-btn:active { transform: translateY(0); }

.ab2-btn--primary {
  background: var(--green); color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(57,105,88,0.3);
}
.ab2-btn--primary:hover { background: var(--green-dark); box-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(57,105,88,0.4); }

.ab2-btn--blue {
  background: var(--blue); color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(65,119,173,0.28);
}
.ab2-btn--blue:hover { background: var(--blue-dark); box-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(65,119,173,0.38); }

.ab2-btn--ghost {
  background: transparent; color: var(--dark);
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}
.ab2-btn--ghost:hover { border-color: var(--dark); background: var(--bg); }

.ab2-btn--ghost-white {
  background: transparent; color: #fff;
  border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
}
.ab2-btn--ghost-white:hover { border-color: #fff; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }

.ab2-btn--lg { padding: 17px 36px; font-size: 17px; }
.ab2-btn--sm { padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 13px; }

.ab2-btn__arrow {
  display: inline-block; transition: transform 0.15s;
}
.ab2-btn:hover .ab2-btn__arrow { transform: translateX(3px); }

.ab2-cta-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; align-items: center; }

/* ── SECTIONS ── */
.ab2-section     { padding: 88px 0; }
.ab2-section--sm { padding: 56px 0; }
.ab2-section--xs { padding: 36px 0; }
.ab2-section--bg { background: var(--bg); }
.ab2-section--dark  { background: var(--bg-dark); }
.ab2-section--ink   { background: var(--bg-ink); }
.ab2-section--green { background: var(--green); }

/* ── TRUST BAR ── */
.ab2-trustbar {
  background: var(--bg-ink); padding: 10px 24px;
  text-align: center; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 18px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.ab2-trustbar__item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
.ab2-trustbar__dot  { width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); }
.ab2-tp-star        { color: var(--tp-green); }

/* ── HERO ── */
.ab2-hero {
  background: var(--bg-dark); position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.ab2-hero__bg {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background-image: url('https://a-diy.com/cdn/shop/files/pressure-treated-kiln-dried-wood-deck-kit-648657.jpg?width=1200');
  background-size: cover; background-position: center 45%;
  opacity: 0.22;
}
.ab2-hero__grad {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(28,38,32,0.97) 0%, rgba(28,38,32,0.75) 50%, rgba(28,38,32,0.5) 100%);
}
.ab2-hero__inner {
  position: relative; z-index: 1;
  padding: 96px 0 88px;
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 420px;
  gap: 60px; align-items: center;
}
.ab2-hero__tag {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); border-radius: 40px;
  padding: 7px 14px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); margin-bottom: 24px;
}
.ab2-hero__tag-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--tp-green); flex-shrink: 0; }
.ab2-hero__sub {
  font-size: clamp(16px, 1.9vw, 19px); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
  max-width: 540px; margin: 22px 0 36px; line-height: 1.65;
}
.ab2-hero__sub strong { color: #fff; }
.ab2-hero__micro { margin-top: 16px; font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); letter-spacing: 0.02em; }

/* Hero stats card */
.ab2-hero__card {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 32px;
}
.ab2-hero__card-title {
  font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
  font-size: 15px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
  margin-bottom: 20px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; font-weight: 400;
  text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
}
.ab2-stat-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
.ab2-stat-row {
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
  padding-bottom: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
}
.ab2-stat-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; padding-bottom: 0; }
.ab2-stat-row__label { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); }
.ab2-stat-row__val {
  font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif; font-size: 22px;
  color: #fff; font-weight: 400;
}
.ab2-stat-row__val--green { color: #7ecfb5; }

/* ── LOGO BAND ── */
.ab2-logos {
  background: var(--bg); border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 22px 0;
}
.ab2-logos__inner {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 30px;
  flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center;
}
.ab2-logos__label {
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap;
}
.ab2-logos__divider { width: 1px; height: 20px; background: var(--border); }
.ab2-logos__tp {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
}
.ab2-logos__tp-score {
  font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
  font-size: 22px; color: var(--dark); font-weight: 400;
}
.ab2-logos__tp-label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.3; }
.ab2-logos__tp-stars { display: flex; gap: 2px; }
.ab2-logos__tp-star  {
  width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--tp-green);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}
.ab2-logos__tp-star svg { width: 10px; height: 10px; fill: #fff; }

/* ── SPLIT INTRO ── */
.ab2-split-intro {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 2px;
}
.ab2-split-intro__panel {
  padding: 56px 48px; position: relative;
}
.ab2-split-intro__panel--left  { background: #fff; border-right: 1px solid var(--border); }
.ab2-split-intro__panel--right { background: var(--bg); }
.ab2-split-intro__label {
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 16px; display: block;
}
.ab2-split-intro__label--red   { color: #b03a2e; }
.ab2-split-intro__label--green { color: var(--green); }
.ab2-split-intro__h {
  font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
  font-size: clamp(22px, 2.8vw, 30px); color: var(--dark);
  margin-bottom: 20px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.2;
}
.ab2-split-intro__body { font-size: 15px; color: var(--mid); line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 24px; }
.ab2-pain-list { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
.ab2-pain-list li {
  display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start;
  font-size: 15px; color: var(--mid); line-height: 1.5;
}
.ab2-pain-list__x {
  width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0;
  background: #fee; border: 1px solid #f5c0bc; margin-top: 1px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #b03a2e;
}
.ab2-check-list { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
.ab2-check-list li {
  display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start;
  font-size: 15px; color: var(--mid); line-height: 1.5;
}
.ab2-check-list__tick {
  width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0;
  background: var(--green-light); border: 1px solid var(--green-mid); margin-top: 1px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--green);
}

/* ── INLINE CTA BAND ── */
.ab2-ctaband {
  background: var(--green); padding: 28px 0;
}
.ab2-ctaband__inner {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.ab2-ctaband__text {
  font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
  font-size: clamp(18px, 2.5vw, 26px); color: #fff; font-weight: 400;
}
.ab2-ctaband__text em { font-style: italic; opacity: 0.75; }
.ab2-ctaband__sub { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); margin-top: 4px; }
.ab2-ctaband__btns { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

/* ── IMAGE+TEXT ROWS ── */
.ab2-imgtext {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0;
  align-items: stretch;
}
.ab2-imgtext--reverse { direction: rtl; }
.ab2-imgtext--reverse-child { direction: ltr; }
.ab2-imgtext__img {
  overflow: hidden;
  min-height: 420px;
}
.ab2-imgtext__img img {
  width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;
  transition: transform 0.6s ease;
}
.ab2-imgtext__img:hover img { transform: scale(1.03); }
.ab2-imgtext__content {
  padding: 56px 52px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center;
}
.ab2-imgtext__content--bg { background: var(--bg); }
.ab2-imgtext__content--dark { background: var(--bg-dark); }
.ab2-imgtext__content--dark .ab2-h3,
